description:
Search what is for sale or rent in Vietnam on this marketplace: apartments and rooms, motorbikes and cars, electronics, furniture, jobs, services and more. Needs no sign-in.

Put what the person wants in `q`, in English or Vietnamese; a district in the words narrows to it ("2 bedroom apartment district 7", "căn hộ quận 2"). Narrow further with `category` and `subcategory` (slugs from list_categories), `province`, `type`, `condition` and a price range in VND. A page holds 10 listings unless you set `limit` (at most 20); pass `next_offset` back as `offset` for the next page.

Returns `total`, `listings` (each with `id`, `title`, `price` and `price_unit`, `negotiable`, `listing_type`, `condition`, `location`, `district`, `city`, `category`, `subcategory`, `image`, `posted_at`, `sponsored` and page `url`), `next_offset` and `capped`. Say a `sponsored` listing is an ad. Use get_listing_details for one listing's full text and photos, and send the person to its `url` to contact the seller.

category.description: Narrow to one category: its slug from list_categories, e.g. "rentals", "vehicles" or "electronics". Leave it out to search every category

condition.description: For items: "new" for new and like-new items, or "used". Leave it out for any condition

lang.description: The language to show titles in where a translation exists: "en" (when left out) or "vi". Use the language the person writes in

limit.description: How many listings to return in this call. Leave it out for a normal-size page of 10; the server caps a larger number

offset.description: Where to continue: the `next_offset` of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page

price_max.description: The highest price the person would pay, in Vietnamese đồng (VND), e.g. 15000000 for 15 million; for a rental, the monthly rent. Leave it out for no upper bound

price_min.description: The lowest price the person wants, in Vietnamese đồng (VND), e.g. 5000000 for 5 million; for a rental, the monthly rent. Leave it out for no lower bound

province.description: The city or province the person wants, e.g. "Ho Chi Minh", "Ha Noi" or "Da Nang". Leave it out to search the whole country

q.description: What the person is looking for, in their own words, English or Vietnamese, e.g. "2 bedroom apartment district 7" or "xe Honda Vision"; a district or area named in the words narrows the results to it. Leave it out to browse a category

sort.description: The order of the results: "best" (when left out) weighs relevance and freshness, "recent" puts the newest first, "price-low" and "price-high" sort by price

subcategory.description: Narrow to one subcategory of that category: its slug from list_categories, e.g. "apartment-rental" under "rentals" or "motorbike" under "vehicles". Leave it out for the whole category

type.description: What kind of listing: "sell" for things for sale, "rent" for rentals, "job" for job offers, "wanted" for people looking to buy or hire. Leave it out for every kind

name: search_listings

capped.description: true when more listings match than this server pages through (the first 220): narrow the search with words, a category or a price instead

listings.description: This page of matching listings, in the `sort` order; empty when nothing matches

category.description: The category slug, as list_categories names it; null when unknown

city.description: The city or province, e.g. "Hồ Chí Minh"; null when not set

condition.description: The item's condition as the seller gave it, usually "new", "like_new" or "used"; null for a job or a service, or when not stated

district.description: The district, e.g. "Quận 7"; null when not set

id.description: The listing id: pass it to get_listing_details for the full description and photos

image.description: The cover photo's URL, ready to show; null when it has none

listing_type.description: What the listing offers: "sell", "rent", "service", "job", "wanted" or "free" (given away); null when unknown

location.description: The area or street the seller gave, e.g. "Thảo Điền"; null when none

negotiable.description: Whether the seller takes offers below the price; null when not stated

posted_at.description: When the listing was posted or last confirmed available, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; null when unknown

price.description: The asking price in Vietnamese đồng (VND), for what `price_unit` says; null when the seller gave none

price_unit.description: What the price is for: "VND" for a one-off price, "VND/month" for a monthly rent or salary, and similar; null when unknown

sponsored.description: true for a paid or commission listing: say it is an ad when you show it

subcategory.description: The subcategory slug within that category, as list_categories names it; null when the listing has none

title.description: The seller's headline for the listing, without contact details

url.description: The listing's page on the site: send the person there to see every photo and contact the seller

next_offset.description: Pass it back as `offset` to get the next page; null on the last page, or when `capped` is true

total.description: About how many live listings match on the whole site, which can be more than this page holds

title: Search listings
